div.div: Every user-owned row carries user_id, and the API writes it as the signed-in user. Original files live in the Supabase Storage bucket user-documents, one folder per user. The runtime graph of a run is stored with the run.

div.div: Row-level security is enabled on every table in rx. Corpus, retrieval, comparison, evaluation and promotion tables have no user policies, so only the backend's service connection reads them.
